youtube_short.title: The Credit Card Grace Period Trap Costs You $3,200
title_alternatives: Carry $1 on Your Card? You're Paying Interest on Everything
Why 'Almost Paid Off' Still Costs You Thousands
youtube_short.description: Here's something credit card companies never tell you: carry any balance over — even one dollar — and your 25-day grace period disappears completely. That means every new purchase starts accruing interest from day one, not from the due date. At today's average 28% APR, households that occasionally carry a balance pay an extra $3,200 a year in interest they thought they'd escaped. 55% of cardholders make this mistake at least once a year. The fix: pay the full statement balance every month, not the minimum, not 99% — the whole thing. #creditcard #personalfinance #moneytrap #financetips

hook_line: Left $1 on your card? You're paying interest on EVERYTHING.
